note: Potato-only classifier: MobileNetV2 (all layers trainable) fine-tuned on the PlantVillage potato subset (aarishasifkhan/plantvillage-potato-disease-dataset), INT8 post-training quantized. Test accuracy 0.9969 on a stratified 15% held-out split. Only detects Potato___Early_blight / Potato___Late_blight / Potato___Healthy — other crops are out of scope until their own models are trained. See docs/MODEL_SPECS.md for the full contract.
